what:
Before and after: every file of the daily refresh system on main and on the branch, as git itself records them.
Run in the repository, on the branch. usage: python3 refresh_compare.py <base-commit> <out-dir>
counted_as_the_refresh_system: everything under .github/, web/, data/ and gateway/; every Python file at the top of the repository (the data modules and the assistants); tools/archive.py and tools/news_publish.py
